node.title: Re: date and time difference
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
timelocal requires the month as a number, you're giving it a string, which is being interpreted as 0 (January). You can see this with a print gmtime($time_1)."\n";. You'd need to convert it from string to number first. Also, since your times are in GMT, you should use timegm instead.

Note that the [mod://Time::Local] docs strongly recommend to use timegm_modern instead. And personally I'd strongly recommend you switch to a better module, such as [mod://Time::Piece], which has a strptime method to parse strings directly, or [mod://DateTime] with [mod://DateTime::Format::Strptime]. Also, your version of Perl if about 15 years old, I would strongly recommend looking into upgrading.
